data.one_liner: Flutter package providing a 360-degree image view with rotation and gesture customisations.
data.what_it_does: Displays a sequence of images to create a 360-degree interactive view. Supports auto-rotation, custom rotation counts, direction, and swipe sensitivity gestures.
use_when: You need to showcase a product or object from 360 degrees using a sequence of images.
You want customizable swipe-to-rotate and auto-rotation capabilities.
avoid_when: You need standard single image loading, caching, or cropping without 360-degree sequencing.
You require interactive 3D model rendering instead of flat image frames.
strengths: Provides built-in auto-rotation and swipe gesture handling.
Supports customizable rotation count, direction, frame change duration, and swipe sensitivity.
weaknesses: Requires manual precaching of images for a smooth experience.
Consumes memory based on the number of frames provided in the image list.
